items.title: DevFest Lokoja 2026
items.text:
Date: 12 December 2026, 09:00 UTC
Ends: 12 December 2026, 13:00 UTC
Location: College of Health Sciences, Adankolo, Behind Specialist Hospital, Lokoja
Registration: Free registration

Kogi's biggest tech gathering returns for 2026!

This year, DevFest Lokoja brings professional developers, non-traditional developers, and tech-savvy builders who create with dev tools without calling themselves developers ("Builders"). Whether you're writing production code, building with AI or no-code tools, launching a startup, or a student simply exploring a tech career, DevFest Lokoja is where you'll learn, find the right connections, and inspiration that will take you to the next level.

Last year's edition drew 500+ people over two days. This year, we're going bigger.

What to expect:

-

Talks and hands-on workshops covering the latest in cloud, AI, mobile, and web

-

Real conversations with the people building Nigeria's tech ecosystem

-

A community that keeps showing up long after the closing keynote

Register now to secure your spot. There's a seat for you.
